responsibilities-in-the-investigation.text: As an investigator, I want each proposed guarantee assigned to its proper model owner so that a missing ledger or consumer premise stays visible.
The data records are specified only in data-model.md. Callable-change ownership is specified only in functions-model.md.

Promote shared identity vocabulary to the nearest existing upstream owner only when the bound ledger and application consumers need the same concept. No new generic registry-free library is authorized by this ticket.
